description: This file is the code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page ('TheoryExam.aspx') that manages the theory exam functionality in an online examination system. It handles loading questions from the database, displaying them to the user, managing user sessions, and submitting answers back to the database.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Partial class for the ASP.NET webpage 'TheoryExam.aspx', handling page load, navigation, and form submission for the online theory exam.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, retrieves questions from the database, sets up the timer, and manages session state.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the course name based on course ID.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the user profile page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Handles the submission of user's answers, inserts data into answers and queue tables, updates course and exam records, and redirects after submission.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the timer label, checks for timeout, and displays remaining time.
